reports.preview: Venue change confirmed: Great American 50Ks moves to Gulfport, plus Sept. 19-26 race intel.

alert.label: VENUE CHANGED
alert.headline: NOW AT GULFPORT DRAGWAY
alert.body: The SDPC Raceshop Great American 50Ks has moved from Montgomery International Dragway to Gulfport Dragway in Gulfport, Mississippi.
bullets: Test & Tune runs Tuesday, October 13, 11 AM-2 PM.
Regular gate entry is available without pre-registration.

feature.title: Run What You Brung Weekend
feature.body: Friday: gates open 5 PM, track hot 6 PM for Test & Tune. Saturday: gates open 3 PM, track hot 5 PM.
bullets: All on 28s Shootout - 7 PM Saturday - $2,500 payout - no shootout entry fee advertised.
Fastest Street Car Shootout - 6 PM Saturday - $500 payout - free entry advertised.
Facebook post lists a $20 gate fee.

questions: Whether 17-inch wheel / 315x50x17 combinations qualify for the 28s class.
Whether AWD cars are allowed in Street Car.
Whether “NHRA rules apply” refers specifically to NHRA safety rules.
Bracket racing has been described as being worked on with NHRA, but no date has been confirmed.

worth.title: Great American 50Ks - Gulfport
worth.body: Four $50K-to-win days, Wednesday through Saturday, October 14-17. Walk-up/gate entry is $250 per entry, per day. Re-entry is $250, first round only.
